# WM6 · Inbox · lỗi tải

Group **WM · Inbox chia sẻ (Next.js)** · state · Next.js: **designed (O5)** (`/inbox`) · account `cs_staff`

## Purpose
State of [WM1](WM1.md) · Inbox · Chờ nhận: lỗi tải. Page: The shared inbox: conversations of patients on the clinic identities, split into the queue "Chờ nhận", the operator's own "Của tôi" and "Tất cả", with the thread beside the list on desktop and as a child screen on a phone. Shows who holds a thread, locks the composer for everybody else, and offers Nhận, Tiếp quản, Trả lại, Giao cho... and the assignment history.

## Agent and care context
- Messages come from clinic.message, the Inbox of record; agent.history (the LLM context) is a different store and never shown here. Presence ("Phạm Quốc Việt đang xem") is only a hint: managers may read a thread silently, the lock is the holder.

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `cs_staff` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `conversation.read` to open; `thread.claim` to Nhận, Tiếp quản and Trả lại (owner, manager, doctor, cs_staff); `thread.assign` for "Giao cho..." (owner, manager); `conversation.reply` to send.
- Roles that can open the page: owner, manager, doctor, cs_staff (hold and answer threads); reception reads only (no claim, no composer).
- Menu entry: "Theo dõi" in the section "Không gian làm việc", shown when the role holds any of `conversation.read`.

## Key actions
- (actions of the page; this state or dialog adds the controls its Layout lists)
- "Nhận" -> POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/claim (dialog "Nhận hội thoại này?")
- "Tiếp quản" -> POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/takeover with a required reason (dialog "Tiếp quản hội thoại")
- "Trả lại" -> POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/release {to_agent, note} (dialog "Trả lại hội thoại")
- "Giao cho..." -> POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/assign (owner, manager)
- "Lịch sử phụ trách" -> GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}/assignments
- "Gửi" -> POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages (409 thread_locked turns the composer into the locked state)
- Tabs, identity filter, search and status chips -> GET /api/v1/conversations and GET /api/v1/identities

## Logic source
- Source: `pema-agent/frontend/src/app/(admin)/inbox/page.tsx`
- Source: `pema-agent/frontend/src/components/ops/inbox/conversation-list.tsx`
- Source: `pema-agent/frontend/src/components/ops/inbox/thread-view.tsx`

- Source: `pema-agent/docs/PLAN-AI01-O.md`
- Shared inbox over one clinic identity (package O). Customers talk to an identity ("Long" on Zalo, "Pema CSKH" bot); operators (owner, manager, doctor, cs_staff) work in Pema only and personal Zalo is a notification bell. Designed in step O5 before it is built in step O6: every WM id has status "designed (O5)", no shots and no snapshot; the frames of "Pema Web (Next.js).dc.html" are the reference.
- The O API behind each control (openapi.json at O2): list GET /api/v1/conversations (assigned_user_id, conversation_status, q); "Nhận" POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/claim; "Tiếp quản" POST .../takeover {reason}; "Trả lại" POST .../release {to_agent, note}; "Giao cho..." POST .../assign {user_id|null}; "Lịch sử phụ trách" GET .../assignments; send POST .../messages (409 thread_locked); staff picker GET /api/v1/staff/assignable; identities GET /api/v1/identities and PATCH /api/v1/identities/{account_id}; on duty GET /api/v1/identities/{account_id}/on-duty; roster GET/POST /api/v1/roster and PATCH/DELETE /api/v1/roster/{entry_id}; "Kết thúc ca" POST /api/v1/staff/{user_id}/end-shift. Live: assignment.changed and inbox.changed on GET /api/v1/events.
- Roles (matrix.py): owner and manager hold thread.assign, thread.end_shift, roster.manage and identity.manage; doctor and cs_staff hold thread.claim and roster.read; reception and accountant never hold a thread. The back end decides, the menu and the buttons only follow it.
- How to reach it (mock BE, `pnpm dev:mock`): sign in as the mock account `cs_staff` → open `/inbox` → condition: GET /api/v1/conversations failing; it must show "Thử lại".

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- Thử lại

## Business rules
- The customer sees the identity only: no operator name, no signature in outgoing text ("Khách thấy tin này từ "Long", không thấy tên nhân viên.").
- Only the holder of a thread replies: a send by another operator answers 409 thread_locked with "<Tên> đang trả lời — Tiếp quản?"; the first reply on an unassigned thread claims it. Takeover needs a reason, kept for staff only, and notifies the previous holder, the new holder and the team group.
- Operators never see a credential: no screen of group WM has a token, cookie, QR payload or any *_enc value. Notifications carry no PII: short code ("#A1B2": four hex digits of the conversation id), identity label, urgency, a masked one-line summary and a deep link that needs login.
- Accountant and reception never hold a thread (ASSIGNABLE_ROLES). Returning a thread "to the care agent" needs the patient in the STAFF state of package M and answers 501 until package M7 wires the care loop.

## Differences from the app design
- Next.js today: the thread has the button "Nhận xử lý" and a "Phụ trách:" picker for every replying role, and a colleague who is replying only gets a warning ("... Bạn vẫn nhắn được, nhưng hãy hỏi đồng nghiệp trước"). Design: "Nhận" (dialog), "Trả lại", "Tiếp quản" (reason), "Lịch sử phụ trách"; the picker becomes "Giao cho..." for owner and manager; a colleague holding the thread locks the composer.
- Old web: the follow-up inbox (WD6, WC14) has no holder or lock; those ids keep their ids, WM adds states instead of renumbering.
- The top-bar bell is a plain link to /inbox today; the design adds /me/notifications (not in the menu) next to it. The "Lịch trực" menu entry is added to the sidebar of the WM frames only (frames WJ-WL keep their sidebar).

## Gotchas
- The WM1 frame at 390 also draws the empty detail card under the list; on a phone the real page shows the list only and opens a thread as a child screen (WM10, WM11 draw that child screen).
- Frames show the conversation code as "#" + four hex digits (joined at run time in parts/WM.js so the canvas check does not read it as a hex colour).
- When O6 creates src/app/(admin)/admin/roster/page.tsx and src/app/(admin)/me/notifications/page.tsx, drop `planned_route` on the WM entries of those routes in lib/catalog-nextjs.cjs (web-inventory.cjs --check says so), and add the menu entry "Lịch trực" to src/lib/nav.tsx.
